subject: spanish
title: Subjects & Verbs
meta_desc: KS3 Spanish: school subjects and verbs.
final_note: Talk about what subjects you take.

walkthroughs.body_html: Subjects: matematicas, espanol, ingles, historia, geografia, ciencias, educacion fisica (PE). Most match English roots.
Estudio = I study. Aprendo = I learn. 'Estudio matematicas' = 'I study maths'.
Me gusta = I like (one thing). Me gustan = I like (many things). 'Me gusta el ingles' = 'I like English'.
